نستمني (form X)
# نَسْتَمْنِي (nastamnī) /nas.tam.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْنَى (istamnā)
# نَسْتَمْنِيَ (nastamniya) /nas.tam.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَمْنَى (istamnā)
